web.description:
# Tax file number and withholding declarations ## On this page - [TFN declaration](https://www.ato.gov.au/businesses-and-organisations/hiring-and-paying-your-workers/payg-withholding/payments-you-need-to-withhold-from/payments-to-employees/tax-file-number-and-withholding-declarations#ato-TFNdeclaration) ## TFN not provided or incorrect If the employee has [applied for a TFN](https://www.ato.gov.au/individuals-and-families/tax-file-number/apply-for-a-tfn), they have 28 days to provide you with their TFN. ### TFN code | TFN code number | When to use code number | |-|-| | 111111111 | The payee
- hasn't provided a valid TFN
- given you a declaration that says they have applied for a TFN.
This code should be updated with the payee’s TFN, or, with the no TFN quoted code when the payee fails to provide the TFN to the payer within the 28-day period allowed. |

web.title: Paper TFN declaration form for payees - Australian Taxation Office
web.description:
# Paper TFN declaration form for payees
## How to complete the paper form
### Question 1 – What is your tax file number (TFN)?
#### If you don't have a TFN but are applying for one
You now have 28 days to provide your TFN to your payer, who must withhold at the standard tax rate during this time. If after 28 days you have not given your TFN to your payer, they will withhold the top rate of tax from future payments.

# Payer information and obligations
## Employee completed paper form
If the payee indicated at Question 1 that they have applied for an individual TFN, or enquired about their existing TFN, they have 28 days to give you their TFN.
